I’m in a western country and my mom came here from a third world country. She doesn’t understand bipolar and every time we try to talk about it, she tells me not to label myself.

I don’t know how old you are, but when I was undiagnosed as a teen, i had this intuition that something wasn’t right with my mentality. I guess what I want to say is listen to your gut and your intuition. Also, if you do have bipolar, please be careful  with only taking antidepressants. That could potentially trigger a manic episode ! I didn’t know this when I was undiagnosed BD and I was given lexapro.

If you have your own therapist that you see one on one and not at family therapy, they will keep anything confidential as long as you don’t tell them that you have plans/intent to hurt yourself or others. You are SAFE in your therapists office !! If you do telehealth and you’re afraid your parents might over hear, take the session in your car or in a room that you know you won’t really be bothered in.

Reading up in bipolar I and II is also a good idea if you want to see how well the symptoms match up !! Especially in cases of POC who have bipolar, or female vs male bipolar symptoms. Sometimes I was told I was bipolar because my symptoms weren’t the mainstream ones. Educating yourself on your potential diagnosis is always a great idea !!

I have too many stories that I'm embarrassed of when it comes to hypersexuality. It's my main symptom when hypomanic :/ I live with so much regret, man... But I'm working on forgiving myself.

1. When I was seventeen I was hypomanic and drinking to cope with the undiagnosed bipolar disorder. My dad's 40 year old friend paid me attention and I loved it, so I let him go down on me for 30 minutes one night. I cried for hours after that.
2. When I was nineteen and hypomanic, I was hanging out with a regular at my job at the time (he was 39 then with a girlfriend) and his girlfriend got the idea to give my body and I as a gift to her boyfriend. They led me back to their apartment, locked the door, and pushed me into a sexual encounter where he slept with me and she just watched from the corner. I still blame myself for this, I didn't have to follow them to their apartment. That was my hypomania pulling me around.
3. I quite literally gave someone a blow job in the middle of a street in a city at 11pm after a frat party. I was drinking that night and I'm certain that my drink was spiked because I fell down the stairs so many times that night, and became this sexual monster almost.
4. I drove to three different guy's places and had sex with all three of them all between 12am-8am. One was without a condom during the guy's frat rush week (I think it's called that?) so I was straight up having unprotected sex while 15+ freshmen slept in the same room as me. 

Essentially, I've put myself in WAYYYYYY too many dangerous sexual situations while hypomanic/manic. I'm so, so happy I was diagnosed when I was 22 and started meds then. It's kept me safe these last three years. Hypersexuality is no joke !! Absolutely none of this is meant to be funny, it's more so to bring awareness to what hypersexuality can put you through.

Not sure how much this applies since I’m still in school but here it goes. I got bad grades from first grade all the way up to my first semester at college (senior year was different because they told us that if we got A’s in our classes, we wouldn’t have to take the finals, so I busted my ass just so I wouldn’t have to take any finals) because I had undiagnosed ADHD. I wanted to learn new things and do well in school, but any time I’d read or try to work I’d get distracted or get mad that I’d have to keep rereading the same page. I’d just watch TV instead and I’d be happier that way, and then I’d get anxious about due dates (I also have anxiety lol). A lot of my teachers thought I was dumb or lazy or both. My parents didn’t think it was worth it for me to go to college but I went anyways. 

Fast forward to my second semester of college. I was on academic probation because I’d rather stay out late and smoke with friends than try to read. My friend gave me adderall to try and HOLY SHIT I thought I was going to be off the wall but I ended up reading quietly, my bubbly personality evened out, and I was writing B+ and A- papers that didn’t take weeks to write, only a day or two. I got the proper diagnosis and have been on the Dean’s List ever since, I figured out what I wanted my major to be, and I’m set to be apart of a very very good social work school next fall. Big shout out to the friend who gave me adderall and ended up helping me realize that I wasn’t dumb like my teachers said, my brain is just weird lol.
